summary.answer: Look up eventHandlers[arg0]. If it is a function, call it with arg1 and return. If a table, call each ipairs value with arg1, in iteration order, and return. Missing or other-typed handlers fall through to printerror; ship/nonship arms print the same invalid-event message. No per-handler exception recovery. The dynamic handler identities remain table/provider evidence gaps.

provider_or_lexical.limit: No binding is inferred from an import, get(), method name or another-file local. Owned closure definitions are in body. Exact source candidate not found in supplied index does not prove source absence.
